documentOperations.notes: Gate values are regression tripwires on a 1,000-entity synthetic scene. The gate skips under -race, where the numbers measure race instrumentation rather than the code. The spec* fields record the product targets from spec section 19. Budgets are calibrated from measured distributions (-count=12), never from a single reading: a single reading once suggested a 2.3x gain the spread did not support. Median set-transform across three states of the command bus: 70.2 ms originally, 42.3 ms after the redundant clone and fingerprint were removed, and 6.2 ms after Document.Clone stopped round-tripping through JSON. Undo tracked it at 73.6, 47.9, and 9.3 ms. The JSON clone spent two thirds of its time parsing text it had just produced; a reflection deep copy of a 1,000-entity scene costs 1.5 ms against 10.4 ms. Current distributions: set-transform 5.6/6.2/7.7 (min/median/max), undo 5.2/9.3/10.7, compile 14.3/17.3/24.0, exact pick 2.9/3.1/3.8, workspace pick 0.17/0.18/0.20, fingerprint 2.7/2.9/3.4, validate 0.36/0.39/0.61. Budgets sit near twice the observed maximum. Re-measure with -count=12 before retightening. A direct commit still copies the document twice — once to apply operations against, once so the caller cannot mutate canonical state — but each copy now costs about 1.5 ms rather than 10, so removing the second is no longer worth changing what Execute returns.
